neighbours.label: the slot that is about to name the kind of person being addressed: 'whether/if you're a | <kind of person>', 'ideal for | <hobbyists> at any level'
fire: Whether you're a first-time buyer or a seasoned investor, our advisers can help.
If you're a teacher looking for classroom ideas, start with chapter two.
Whether you are a casual runner or a marathon veteran, these shoes will suit you.
The course is ideal for photographers at any level of experience.
If you're a student on a budget, the weekday pass is the best deal.
Whether you're a knitter or a quilter, you'll find plenty of patterns here.
The handbook is written for birdwatchers of all abilities.
Whether you are a home cook or a professional chef, this knife belongs in your kitchen.
quiet: Whether it's a first-time visit or a return trip, the island never disappoints.
If there's a storm coming, start with the shutters on the north side.
Whether it is a short jog or a long race, drink water before you start.
The paint is ideal for walls in damp rooms.
If it's a matter of budget, the weekday pass is the best deal.
Whether it's a scarf or a blanket, the pattern uses the same stitch.
The handbook is printed on paper of high quality.
Whether it is a weeknight dinner or a holiday feast, this pan can handle it.

notes: Card: ' a' after 'Whether you're', ' for'/' among' before astronomers, designers, enthusiasts, amateurs. Probes: you're a beginner 0.68, for gardeners at any level 0.71; 'whether it's a rainy day' 0.20, 'perfect for rainy weather' 0.19. ' among' fires 0.47 whatever follows, so it is left out of the test. Card flags the pole broad (1.2%).
